questions.question: What was Guru Ram Das Ji's name before he became the Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji was named Jetha (meaning 'firstborn') as a child and later became known as Ram Das.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Ram Das, Guru

questions.question: In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji was born in Chuna Mandi, Lahore (now in Pakistan), to Baba Hari Das and Mata Daya Kaur.

questions.question: Guru Ram Das Ji married Bibi Bhani Ji, the daughter of which Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji married Bibi Bhani Ji, daughter of Guru Amar Das Ji, and stayed on at Goindwal in the Guru's service.

questions.question: Which city was founded by Guru Ram Das Ji?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji founded the town first known as Ramdaspur or Chakk Guru, which grew into Amritsar around its sacred sarovar.

questions.question: Which composition of Guru Ram Das Ji is sung during the Sikh marriage ceremony (Anand Karaj)?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji composed the four Laavan and advised Sikhs to use them in marriage, giving Sikhs a distinct marriage ceremony, the Anand Karaj.

questions.question: How many rounds (laavan) does the couple take around Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji during the Anand Karaj?
questions.explanation: The Laavan hymn of Guru Ram Das Ji has four stanzas, and the couple walks around Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji once for each stanza.

questions.question: Who succeeded Guru Ram Das Ji as the fifth Guru?
options: Guru Arjan Dev Ji, his youngest son
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji named his youngest son, Guru Arjan Dev Ji, as the Fifth Nanak.

questions.question: Amritsar's international airport is named after which Guru?
questions.explanation: The airport is Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport, honouring the Guru who founded Amritsar.
questions.source: Incredible India (Govt. of India): Gurudwara Baba Atal Sahib
questions.note: Airport name appears in the travel section of the cited page.

questions.question: Guru Ram Das Ji organised Sikhs who travelled to distant places to collect offerings and spread the Guru's message. What were they called?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji set up the masand system, replacing the earlier manji system, to fund the sarovar and langar and to spread Sikhi.

questions.question: In which raag of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji are the Laavan found?
questions.explanation: The Laavan of Guru Ram Das Ji are in Raag Suhi, on angs 773-774 of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji.

questions.question: The shabad 'So Purakh', recited in Rehras Sahib, was composed by which Guru?
questions.explanation: 'So Purakh' is a composition of Guru Ram Das Ji in Raag Asa, found on ang 10 of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji and recited in Rehras Sahib.

questions.question: How many hymns of Guru Ram Das Ji are included in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji's 638 hymns, composed in 30 raags, are included in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji.

questions.question: As a young boy, how did Bhai Jetha earn his living?
questions.explanation: Orphaned and poor, young Jetha sold boiled grams, first at Basarke and later at Goindwal.

questions.question: After his parents died, who brought up young Bhai Jetha?
options: Baba Buddha Ji, at Ramdas village
A family friend in Khadur Sahib
questions.explanation: Jetha lost both parents at about seven, and his maternal grandmother took him to her village, Basarke.

questions.question: Which of these was an early name of the city of Amritsar?
questions.explanation: The town founded by Guru Ram Das Ji was first called Ramdaspur, Chakk Ramdas or Chakk Guru before it became known as Amritsar.

questions.question: Sikh sources record that land for Ramdaspur was bought from the landowners of which neighbouring village?
questions.explanation: Land for the new town was bought from the zamindars of Tung (and, per SGPC, also Gilwali and Gumtala). Another tradition says the land was a gift from Akbar to Bibi Bhani.
questions.note: An alternative account (gift from Akbar) exists; question phrased as 'Sikh sources record ... bought from'.

questions.question: Which renowned Sikh was sent by Guru Ram Das Ji to preach in Agra?
questions.explanation: Bhai Gurdas, the best known of the masands, was sent by Guru Ram Das Ji to teach the Sikh message in Agra.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Ram Das, Guru

questions.question: Which elder brother of Guru Arjan Dev Ji hid his letters to Guru Ram Das Ji?
questions.explanation: Prithi Chand intercepted Guru Arjan Dev Ji's first two letters from Lahore; when the third reached Guru Ram Das Ji, the deception was exposed.
questions.source: The Sikh Encyclopedia: Ram Das, Guru

questions.question: Guru Ram Das Ji began digging one sarovar but suspended the work to concentrate on the Amritsar Sarovar. Which was it?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji started Santokhsar, then paused it to focus on the Amritsar Sarovar; Guru Arjan Dev Ji later completed Santokhsar.

questions.question: Where did Guru Ram Das Ji spend his final days and leave his body in 1581?
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji left Amritsar, retired to Goindwal Sahib and passed away there in 1581.
